_readme: Labels are relative to the documents of the service the user picked ('service'; null = all services):
SUFFICIENT   - the documents answer the question. (Not listed here: every verified case in retrieval_test_set.json is imported automatically as SUFFICIENT.)
INSUFFICIENT - the TOPIC is covered by that service's documents, but this specific detail is missing or only partly there.
OUT_OF_SCOPE - the documents have nothing to do with the question.

Only cases with verified=true are used. To verify a case: run  python scripts/search_chunks.py --service <service> --query "<query>"  and read the top chunks. Decide the label honestly from what the documents say, fix 'label' if my guess is wrong, then set verified=true.
'expected_suggestion' (optional) is the service the frontend should suggest switching to when the user picked the wrong service.
The OUT_OF_SCOPE cases oos-01..oos-12 are everyday topics unrelated to passport, Aadhaar, KCC or voter ID, so I marked them verified. Un-verify any you disagree with.
INSUFFICIENT and wrong-service cases are only my guesses: they stay verified=false until you check them against the documents.
split='tune' is used while calibrating; split='final' should be scored once at the end.
